passages.text: A song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
passages.sermon: This is a song.\r\nThis is a psalm.\r\nThe sons of Korah wrote it.

passages.text: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, His holy mountain.
passages.sermon:
This is a song.
The sons of Korah wrote this song.
The LORD is great.
The LORD deserves much praise.
The LORD is in the city of our God.
The LORD is on His holy mountain.
passages.original: שִׁ֥יר מִ֝זְמוֹר לִבְנֵי־ קֹֽרַח׃ גָּ֘ד֤וֹל יְהוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד בְּעִ֥יר אֱ֝לֹהֵ֗ינוּ הַר־ קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃

passages.text: Beautiful in loftiness, the joy of all the earth, like the peaks of Zaphon is Mount Zion, the city of the great King.
passages.sermon:
Mount Zion stands high.
Mount Zion is beautiful.
Mount Zion brings joy to all the earth.
Mount Zion rises like the peaks of Zaphon.
Mount Zion is the city of the great King.
passages.original: יְפֵ֥ה נוֹף֮ מְשׂ֪וֹשׂ כָּל־ הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ הַר־ צִ֭יּוֹן יַרְכְּתֵ֣י צָפ֑וֹן קִ֝רְיַ֗ת מֶ֣לֶךְ רָֽב׃

passages.text: God is in her citadels; He has shown Himself to be a fortress.
passages.sermon: God is present in her strongholds.\r\nGod has shown Himself to be a place of safety.\r\nGod protects His people like a fortress.

passages.text: For behold, the kings assembled; they all advanced together.
passages.sermon: Many kings came together.\r\nThey gathered in one place.\r\nThey moved forward as one group.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ הִנֵּ֣ה הַ֭מְּלָכִים נֽוֹעֲד֑וּ עָבְר֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו׃

passages.text: They saw and were astounded; they fled in terror.
passages.sermon:
The kings saw.
They were astounded.
They became afraid.
They hurried away in terror.
passages.original: הֵ֣מָּה רָ֭אוּ כֵּ֣ן תָּמָ֑הוּ נִבְהֲל֥וּ נֶחְפָּֽזוּ׃

passages.text: Trembling seized them there, anguish like a woman in labor.
passages.sermon:
The kings saw something.
Trembling seized the kings at that place.
Anguish gripped them.
Their anguish was like the pain of a woman in labor.

passages.text: With a wind from the east You wrecked the ships of Tarshish.
passages.sermon:
God acted with power.
God sent a strong wind from the east.
This wind broke the ships of Tarshish.
God destroyed these ships.

passages.text: As we have heard, so we have seen in the city of the LORD of Hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish her forever. Selah Within Your temple, O God, we contemplate Your loving devotion.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is God.
God has a city.
We heard about this city before.
Now we have seen this city ourselves.
This city belongs to our God.
God will make this city strong forever.
We are in Your temple, O God.
We think about Your faithful love there.
passages.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר שָׁמַ֨עְנוּ׀ כֵּ֤ן רָאִ֗ינוּ בְּעִיר־ יְהוָ֣ה צְ֭בָאוֹת בְּעִ֣יר אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ אֱלֹ֘הִ֤ים יְכוֹנְנֶ֖הָ עַד־ עוֹלָ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃ דִּמִּ֣ינוּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ בְּ֝קֶ֗רֶב הֵיכָלֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Your name, O God, like Your praise, reaches to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD of Hosts.
God is our God.
God’s name is great.
God’s name reaches to the ends of the earth.
God’s praise also reaches to the ends of the earth.
God’s right hand is full of righteousness.
passages.original: כְּשִׁמְךָ֤ אֱלֹהִ֗ים כֵּ֣ן תְּ֭הִלָּתְךָ עַל־ קַצְוֵי־ אֶ֑רֶץ צֶ֝֗דֶק מָלְאָ֥ה יְמִינֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Mount Zion is glad, the daughters of Judah rejoice, on account of Your judgments.
passages.sermon: Mount Zion is glad.\r\nThe daughters of Judah rejoice.\r\nThey are glad because of Your judgments.
passages.original: יִשְׂמַ֤ח׀ הַר־ צִיּ֗וֹן תָּ֭גֵלְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה לְ֝מַ֗עַן מִשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: March around Zion, encircle her, count her towers, consider her ramparts, tour her citadels, that you may tell the next generation.
passages.sermon:
Zion is the holy city of God.
Walk around Zion.
Go all the way around her.
Count her towers.
Look carefully at her ramparts.
Walk through her citadels.
Do these things so you can tell the next generation.
passages.original: סֹ֣בּוּ צִ֭יּוֹן וְהַקִּיפ֑וּהָ סִ֝פְר֗וּ מִגְדָּלֶֽיהָ׃ שִׁ֤יתוּ לִבְּכֶ֨ם׀ לְֽחֵילָ֗ה פַּסְּג֥וּ אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ לְמַ֥עַן תְּ֝סַפְּר֗וּ לְד֣וֹר אַחֲרֽוֹן׃

passages.text: For this God is our God forever and ever; He will be our guide even till death.
passages.sermon:
God is our God.
He is the God of Israel.
He is our God forever.
He is our God for all time.
He will guide us.
He will guide us until death.
passages.original: כִּ֤י זֶ֨ה׀ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֱ֭לֹהֵינוּ עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד ה֖וּא יְנַהֲגֵ֣נוּ עַל־ מֽוּת׃
